description.value: CMH Valemount Lodge is Canadian Mountain Holidays' most exclusive heli-skiing destination — a private, 10-room luxury post-and-beam lodge deep in BC's remote Cariboo Range. Guests reach the property exclusively by private jet charter and personal helicopter, with access to over 400 runs across the largest CMH tenure. In addition to winter ski programs, the lodge offers guided heli-accessed hiking adventures in summer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms CMH Valemount Lodge is a real, operational luxury heli-skiing destination operated by Canadian Mountain Holidays, featuring a 10-room post-and-beam lodge in BC's Cariboo Range. The site explicitly states guests access the lodge exclusively by private jet charter and personal helicopter — no road access is described or implied. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, laundry, etc.) are mentioned anywhere across the fetched pages; the phone 1-800-661-0252 appears on the website but was absent from OSM tags.
concerns: Lodge is accessed exclusively by private jet charter and personal helicopter with no road access — physically unreachable by touring cyclists without helicopter transport. Directory team should consider whether helicopter-only wilderness lodges belong in a cycling tourism context.
